tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_retailer
tools.description: The connected store: id, name, domain prefix, store URL, country, currency, time zone, tax-exclusive setting, loyalty and gift-card settings. Good first call (use the time zone to turn a local day into UTC for sales searches). GET /retailer.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_outlets
tools.description: List the store's outlets (locations): id, name, address, currency, time zone, default tax. Use the outlet id to filter sales, stock and stock orders. Paginate with next_after. GET /outlets.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_outlet
tools.description: One outlet by id. GET /outlets/{outlet_id}.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_registers
tools.description: List registers (tills): id, name, outlet_id, is_open, open/close times and invoice numbering. Paginate with next_after. GET /registers.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_register_payments_summary
tools.description: Payment totals by payment type for one register since it was opened (the end-of-day / cash-up view). GET /registers/{register_id}/payments_summary.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_taxes
tools.description: List tax groups and their rates (id, name, is_default, rates). The vendor returns the whole list in one reply (no cursor). GET /taxes.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_users
tools.description: List the store's users (staff): id, username, display name, email, account type (cashier, manager, admin), enabled flag, restricted outlets. Paginate with next_after. GET /users.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_user_sale_totals
tools.description: Sales totals for one staff user, as the vendor computes them (no date filter; use sales_summary for a period). GET /users/{user_id}/sale_totals.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_products
tools.description: List products (variants) in the catalog: id, family_id, sku, variant_name, prices (price_excluding_tax / price_including_tax), active flags, codes, suppliers, version. The product NAME lives on the product family: add includes=["families"] to get it. Paginate with next_after (stop when data is empty

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_product
tools.description: One product (variant) by id, with its prices, codes, suppliers and outlet taxes. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_search_products
tools.description: Filter products by SKU, brand, supplier, tag, product type or variant parent. Uses offset paging: pass next_offset to continue (null = last page). GET /search?type=products.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_inventory_levels
tools.description: Stock on hand per product per outlet: product_id, location_id (= outlet id), current_inventory_level, reorder threshold/amount, quantity_to_procure, average cost, total cost, supplier. Filter by outlet_ids, product_ids (or root_product_ids for variant families), supplier_ids; to_be_procured_only kee

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_brands
tools.description: List product brands (id, name). Paginate with next_after. GET /brands.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_tags
tools.description: List product tags (id, name). Paginate with next_after. GET /tags.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers: id, name, default markup and contact details. Paginate with next_after. GET /suppliers.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_consignments
tools.description: List consignments: supplier stock orders (type SUPPLIER), transfers between outlets (OUTLET), stocktakes (STOCKTAKE) and returns (RETURN), with status (OPEN, SENT, DISPATCHED, RECEIVED, STOCKTAKE_*, CLOSED, CANCELLED), outlet, supplier, due and received dates, totals. Paginate with next_after. GET /

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_consignment
tools.description: One consignment (stock order, transfer, stocktake or return) by id. GET /consignments/{consignment_id}.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_consignment_products
tools.description: The product lines of one consignment: product_id, SKU, ordered count, received quantity, cost. Paginate with next_after (stop when data is empty). GET /consignments/{consignment_id}/products.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_sales
tools.description: Sales in version order, oldest changes first: the way to sync everything that changed. It has NO date filter: for a period use search_sales or sales_summary. Each sale: id, date, invoice_number, state, customer_id, source (outlet, register, user), payments, line_items, totals. Paginate with next_aft

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_sale
tools.description: One sale by id with its line items, payments, taxes and totals. GET /sales/{sale_id}.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_search_sales
tools.description: Find sales by date range (UTC), state, outlet, register, user, customer, payment type, product or invoice number. Uses offset paging: pass next_offset to continue (null = last page). Replies can be large: for totals over a period use sales_summary instead of paging through this. GET /search?type=sal

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_sales_summary
tools.description: Totals for a period computed here from up to max_pages x page_size sales, so a report needs ONE tool call instead of dozens: sale count and net / tax / gross (tax-inclusive) totals, plus breakdowns by state, UTC day, outlet and payment type name, and the top products by quantity. tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_customers
tools.description: List customers in version order: id, customer_code, name, email, phone, balance, loyalty_balance, year_to_date, customer group. To find one by name or email use search_customers. Paginate with next_after (stop when data is empty). GET /customers.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_search_customers
tools.description: Find customers by email, first name, last name, company name, phone, mobile or customer code. Uses offset paging: pass next_offset to continue (null = last page). GET /search?type=customers.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id: contact details, addresses, customer group, balance, loyalty balance, year-to-date spend. GET /customers/{customer_id}.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_list_customer_groups
tools.description: List customer groups (id, name). Use the id as customer_group_id when creating or updating a customer. Paginate with next_after. GET /customer_groups.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a new customer. Give at least a first name, last name or company name. Check search_customers first so you do not create a duplicate. POST /customers.

tools.name: lightspeedxseries_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing customer. Only the fields you pass change: the tool first reads the customer and sends the vendor its full record with your changes applied (the vendor's update is a full PUT). tools.description: WRITE: set the selling price of one product (variant). Pass price_excluding_tax or price_including_tax as a decimal string such as "24.99" (set one; the store's tax setting decides which the till uses). Nothing else on the product changes. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: lightspeedxseries_get_retailer, lightspeedxseries_list_users, lightspeedxseries_get_inventory_levels, lightspeedxseries_list_customers, lightspeedxseries_search_customers, lightspeedxseries_create_customer · Private data: lightspeedxseries_list_suppliers, lightspeedxseries_get_customer, lightspeedxseries_update_customer · Public sink: lightspeedxseries_list_users, lightspeedxseries_get_inventory_levels, lightspeedxseries_list_customers, lightspeedxseries_search_customers, lightspeedxseries_create_customer · Destructive: lightspeedxseries_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: lightspeedxseries_get_retailer, lightspeedxseries_list_users, lightspeedxseries_get_inventory_levels, lightspeedxseries_list_customers, lightspeedxseries_search_customers, lightspeedxseries_create_customer · Private data: lightspeedxseries_list_suppliers, lightspeedxseries_get_customer, lightspeedxseries_update_customer · Public sink: lightspeedxseries_list_users, lightspeedxseries_get_inventory_levels, lightspeedxseries_list_customers, lightspeedxseries_search_customers, lightspeedxseries_create_customer · Destructive: lightspeedxseries_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
